clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that teaches adventurers the culinary arts as the vital foundation for wilderness survival. By learning to start a campfire from Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village, travelers unlock the ability to pitch their own campsites in the wild.

For an adventurer traveling across untamed lands, understanding survival begins with the hearth. Camping 101: Cooking introduces wanderers to the art of culinary craft, not merely for preparing meals, but because mastering a basic fire is the essential first step to establishing a safe resting spot in the wild.

Aspiring campers are directed to speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn the fundamentals of the cooking trade. Once an adventurer understands how to kindle a campfire, they gain the ability to establish a small campsite anywhere across the wilderness. Although rudimentary camps support only minimal furnishings, improving one's craft allows for larger fires and richer arrangements crafted with aid from other tradeskills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
